summary: Add localized, non-message translation help on customer/staff chat entry and neutral delivery-only quality copy below price/options for verified BunsikClub menu identities. Ambiguous jajangmyeon/naengmyeon identities remain excluded.
businessInvariants: Do not change any menu price, tax, availability, quantity, order RPC, bank configuration, Auth or permission.
Informational notice is delivery-only, store-scoped and exact catalog-ID scoped; pickup, other stores and combo titles do not inherit the note.
Preserve existing menu descriptions, size choices and complete KO/VI/EN text without truncation.
Translation help is presentation-only on chat entry; it never becomes a stored or sent conversation message and follows the viewer locale.

Optional informationFooter is null by default for all existing shared menu pickers. Preserve required option validation, selected keys, prices and explicit confirmation; review all transitive consumers.
Jajangmyeon versus Jjagyechi and cold-noodle variants remain unresolved and excluded; no name-based runtime selection or speculative identity assignment.
